Email "Innagurual Retro GEMPC SWCCG - Conclusion" from [[Andy Talaga]], tournament director, to the players of the first Retro GEMPC, the [[2025 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]], sent 9 July 2025. It congratulates [[Timo Dusel]] on winning undefeated through seven rounds, links the top 8 decklists, gives an update on prizes, asks players to fill in a survey and lists the final standings for all 96 players (place 82 is a tie).

== Source ==
* Email from Andy Talaga to the event's players, 9 July 2025. Received by [[Bill Bisco]] as a player and printed from Gmail to PDF on 13 October 2026; provided by Bill.

== Changes ==
* Redacted copy: every email address and the Gmail print header's page address are blacked out, and the pages are rasterised. The message text, names and standings are otherwise unchanged.
